title: Letters and Kitchen
author: Kestrel Thackeray
blurb: Sebastian Amberdale, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
